races.paceDynamic: Tuba and Lednikov are both confirmed front runners who will clash from the start, with Tuba having made all to win here six weeks ago and Lednikov a six-time winner who likes to dominate. Green Team will track them prominently, creating a contested early pace that should develop into an honest gallop over this 1m6f trip. The sustained pace battle up front will set up the race perfectly for the strong contingent of hold-up horses including Daaris, V Power, Fine Print and Sneaky Blinder. This race shape clearly favours closers who can finish strongly off the guaranteed pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Tuba and Lednikov engage in a prolonged early battle with Green Team tracking close
scenarios.body: The pace duel will compromise the leaders in the final furlong, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past with superior finishing kicks. Daaris thrives in these conditions at the course while V Power has winning form off similar setups.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Tuba gets an uncontested lead like his winning effort six weeks ago
scenarios.body: Without early pressure, Tuba can dictate fractions and kick clear in the straight as he did before, with Green Team picking up the pieces. The hold-up horses will struggle to close the gap from too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Mid-Race Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses and multiple horses bunch up turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where prominent racers like Green Team can outgun the hold-up horses who need more time to wind up. Arch Legend's fresh legs could also surprise from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lednikov Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Lednikov asserts from the start and Tuba settles off the pace
scenarios.body: The experienced eight-year-old uses his class to control the race from pillar to post, with his recent Southwell dominance translating to this surface. His 70 TopSpeed rating suggests he has the raw ability when things go his way.

watchPoints.text: Tuba could steal this if he gets the uncontested lead he enjoyed six weeks ago
Watch the early battle between Tuba and Lednikov to determine if pace scenario develops
Fine Print with Oisin Murphy taking the ride represents significant stable confidence despite poor Friday run
Green Team's recent stable switch could see improvement but needs to prove he can handle the pace battle
V Power's tongue-tie worked last time and Zoe Lewis has strong record with this horse

races.paceDynamic: Beat The Odds is the lone confirmed front runner in this 11-runner handicap, meaning she can dictate terms without early pressure and set a sustainable gallop. With only Brinton showing prominent tendencies, the majority of the field (Relevant Range, Book Of Life, Crafter, Merapi, Wave Rock, Molly Valentine, Arlecchino's Rex, Tiger Beetle, Wicklow Way) will be held up in the pack behind a modest early tempo. This creates a compressed field turning for home with plenty of horses needing luck in running over this 1m1½f trip. The uncontested lead and lack of early pace strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without fighting for it.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Beat The Odds jumps cleanly and gets an easy lead without being pressured by Brinton early
scenarios.body: She dictates comfortable fractions and has enough in hand to resist the late challenge, while the hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind the slow pace. This heavily favours the two pace-setting types who avoid the scramble.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up behind Beat The Odds' slow pace and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The superior class horses with turn of foot can unleash late despite positioning, with Wave Rock and Crafter having the ratings to exploit the tactical scenario. Strong finishers benefit from the compressed field and tactical nature.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Beat The Odds stops quickly in the final furlong after setting slow fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where positioning and luck matter more than ability, favouring horses drawn well or getting clear runs. In-form runners like Brinton and recent winner Wicklow Way can capitalize on the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Class Rising Up
scenarios.trigger: If the handicapper has been too generous and the higher-rated horses show their true ability
scenarios.body: Despite tactical disadvantages, superior horses like Relevant Range and Merapi use their class edge to overcome poor positioning. This requires everything to fall right for the hold-up horses with traffic problems unlikely.

watchPoints.text: Beat The Odds breaking slowly would eliminate the main pace angle and create a messy early scramble for position
Brinton's starting habits as she's been blowing the break recently, which would hand Beat The Odds an unassailable lead
Wave Rock's early positioning under Oisin Murphy as his hold-up style needs the race to develop properly to be effective
Crafter's break from the stalls as slow starts have cost him recently despite the dual course winning record
Traffic problems in the home straight given nine of eleven runners prefer to be held up behind what will be a slow pace

races.paceDynamic: Celestra will lead from the start with She Commands and Wild Violet tracking in behind, setting up a moderate early gallop that should suit the patient types. The pace will be honest but not frenetic, with Celestra having room to dictate terms without serious early pressure from rivals. Musical Accord and Hot Silk will settle further back, while Six Blue's tendency to pull hard could disrupt her own rhythm. This shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the leaders face a long run-in without brutal early fractions to soften them up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Dictate Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Celestra and She Commands control the pace without pressure through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The front pair stretch clear turning for home with fresher legs than expected, making it hard for closers to bridge the gap. Celestra's proven stamina and She Commands' class tell in a front-running finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace allows hold-up horses perfect positioning entering the final three furlongs
scenarios.body: Musical Accord and Hot Silk benefit from the patient ride, sweeping past tiring leaders in the closing stages. The 1m1½f trip plays to their strengths with room to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Pack Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Wild Violet or She Commands track the pace perfectly and quicken at the ideal moment
scenarios.body: The prominent racers avoid the early pace battle while staying close enough to pounce when leaders tire. Their tactical positioning proves decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Celestra goes too slow early and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where any horse can win from any position. Six Blue's poor finishing record becomes less relevant in a scramble.

watchPoints.text: Six Blue's tendency to pull hard could see her race too keenly over this shorter trip, compromising her finishing effort
Musical Accord missed the break badly last time from a wide stall and needs to jump cleanly to execute hold-up tactics

She Commands returning after 213-day absence, watch for any signs of ring-rustiness in the preliminaries

races.paceDynamic: Aspire To Glory is the sole confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable tempo without pressure, having previously won over this course and distance. With 12 hold-up horses behind him, this creates a tactical race where the pace will be steady early before quickening from the home turn. The lack of pace pressure means Aspire To Glory can dictate terms, while the mass of hold-up runners will be relying on a strong finish. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position closer to the pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a traffic-heavy finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If Aspire To Glory gets an easy lead and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The front runner can control fractions and kick clear when the field bunches up behind, while traffic problems plague the closers in a crowded finish. Prominent runners who can track the leader benefit from the clean run and tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and allows superior finishing speed to dominate
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup with a crawling pace, enabling the best finishers to unleash devastating late runs. Quality over positioning wins out as the race becomes a pure stamina test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Strike
scenarios.trigger: If tactical runners position perfectly in midfield and avoid the late traffic
scenarios.body: Horses with enough early speed to avoid the pack but stamina to finish get the best of both worlds. They escape the crowding that catches the back-markers while having enough left to reel in a tiring leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Aspire To Glory stops quickly and creates a bunched finish with multiple hard-luck stories
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with traffic problems throughout the field as horses struggle for racing room. Only those with the clearest runs or rail positions can capitalize on the leader's demise.

races.paceDynamic: Crystal Pier will likely lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners in this small field. Squiffy and Silky Lass as prominent runners may track close but shouldn't apply significant pressure early. The pace will be sustainable rather than testing, allowing the field to stay compact through the middle stages before a sprint finish develops. This shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick, particularly Searchingtheblues, Eastern Veil, Lady Milton and Kilkenny Warrior who all prefer to come from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Crystal Pier sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays moderate
scenarios.body: The field bunches up turning for home allowing the closers to unleash their kicks. Multiple hold-up horses get clear runs and overhaul the early leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the field and exposes the hold-up horses who need cover. The prominent runners have enough left to hold off late challenges from those coming from behind.

scenarios.body: Early positioning becomes crucial as several hold-up horses encounter trouble in running. The winners are those who avoid the interference or get the clearest passages.
